title: federation: no authorization on presence subscribe
description: Pre-existing, surfaced by f82v. Peer/subscribePresence has no check on who may subscribe to whose presence: any bound identity on any peer domain can subscribe to any recipientUserId and learn online status. Now that one domain hosts many mailboxes, a peer can watch every user it can name. Decide the rule, e.g. receiver SHOULD accept a subscription only from an identity that is a ChatContact of (or shares a Chat with) the recipient, else answer as for an existing mailbox with no subscription (no enumeration signal).
